headline: Orlen Receives First US LNG Cargo Under 20-Year Venture Global Contract
summary: The LNG carrier Swieta Barbara arrived in Poland carrying a cargo from Louisiana equivalent to nearly 95 million cubic meters of regasified gas, marking the start of a 20-year supply agreement between Orlen and Venture Global.
why: Long-term liquefied natural gas supply contracts secure diversified energy imports and support European energy security diversification away from pipeline dependencies.

impacts.name: Orlen
impacts.why: Long-term LNG procurement contracts secure multi-decade fuel inputs for regional energy distribution.
